name: self-produced-duo-both-performers
rule: A self-produced show with 1-2 named leads pursues EACH performer directly (#366), never the act. The show has one letter (#3549), so where both leads are emailed together it names them rather than addressing one of them as you.

sources.label: Duo's own concert page
sources.content: Virgile Roche and Nora Calder make their U.S. debut at Carnegie Hall on March 10, 2026. This recital is self-produced by the two pianists.

draft.subject: Photographing the Roche and Pierre Duo's March 10 recital at Carnegie Hall
draft.body: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to the Roche and Pierre Duo's March 10 recital at Carnegie Hall. I work in an unobtrusive documentary style, no flash, so the audience doesn't notice me and nothing on stage is disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about the photography plans for the recital. I look forward to hearing from you.
